title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2610.22353v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. Modern MoE architectures increasingly combine two design choices: fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts. The former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio, and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token. We identify an exploration dilemma between these designs: shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations. This conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space. Consequently, the additional expressiveness offered by fine-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice. translated_title: 重新思考现代混合专家模型中的路由探索
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型已成为扩展模型参数规模的重要方法。现代MoE架构日益结合两种设计选择：细粒度专家分割与共享专家。前者通过在固定激活比例下支持更多专家组合来提升模型表达能力，后者则引入了对每个token都保持激活的专家。我们识别出这两种设计之间存在一种探索困境：共享专家通过降低token表示的多样性而削弱了路由的探索性，这与细粒度专家分割因组合式扩大的路由空间而产生的更大探索需求相冲突。因此，细粒度分割所提供的额外表达能力在实践中可能无法充分发挥。我们提出MirrorMoE，通过token自适应抑制不必要探索的方式来缩小探索空间，从而调和这一探索困境。
tldr: 本文揭示了现代MoE架构中共享专家削弱路由探索性与细粒度专家分割需要更大探索空间之间的冲突，并提出MirrorMoE通过token自适应抑制来缩小探索空间以解决该困境。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies an exploration dilemma between shared experts (which reduce routing exploration) and fine-grained expert segmentation (which demands more exploration) in modern MoE, and proposes MirrorMoE to reconcile it by shrinking the exploration space via token-adaptive suppression.
